summary.en: Open-source media player. Release v0.42.0 lists Windows arm64 builds (mpv and libmpv).
summary.zh-TW: 開源媒體播放器，v0.42.0 版提供 Windows arm64 組建（mpv 與 libmpv）。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

evidence.title: mpv v0.42.0 release: mpv-v0.42.0-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip and aarch64-w64-mingw32 builds
